svg.title: Scale AI Framework: From Pilot to Enterprise
svg.desc: Three phases in sequence. Phase 1, unlock value: prove ROI with two to three pilots, secure executive sponsorship and define KPIs. Phase 2, organise for success: AI Council plus Centre of Excellence plus business unit leads, with clear roles to decide, build and govern. Phase 3, empower business users: broad Copilot rollout, self-service with Copilot Studio, and a champions programme plus training.
svg.text: Scale AI Framework: From Pilot to Enterprise
Prove value first, then organise, then hand capability to business users.
